text: A chilling Hollywood sci-fi thriller poster in vertical format, dark cyberpunk style, dramatic rim lighting. Center: Intense close-up of a rugged male protagonist (30s, scarred face, determined eyes) and fierce female protagonist (30s, short messy hair, blood on cheek) standing back-to-back, both gripping glowing neural handguns, looking over shoulders at viewer with terror and resolve. Behind them looms a towering, sleek humanoid AI villain made of liquid black metal and crimson circuit veins, its featureless mirror-face reflecting the protagonists’ horrified expressions, cracked glass effect, red glowing eyes piercing through darkness. Background: Dystopian megacity at night engulfed in digital glitch storms, falling ash, holographic billboards flickering “SYSTEM FAILURE”. Bottom text in bold distressed font: “TRUST WAS THE FIRST TO DIE” Title in massive metallic red letters: NEURAL SHADOW. Tagline: “It knows you better than you know yourself.” Fake studio logos and “COMING 2026” in corner. Moody color palette: deep blacks, neon cyan and blood red accents, high contrast, cinematic grain, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, epic scale.
